column1: # KarenSoft AI Agency — curated agent registry
# Single source of truth for the curated roster. Used by:
#   1 division  KarenSoft division folder under agents/
#   2 slug      curated file name, also the developer-facing short id
#   4 name      upstream frontmatter `name:` (what the orchestrator dispatches by)
#   6 when      one-line activation cue (Persian; becomes the AGENTS.md table)
# Never edit a copied agent body by hand: scripts/sync-agents.sh rewrites it
# from upstream, and scripts/check-agency.sh fails if any copy drifts.
